patches.summary: Register the eight hand-authored transcendence commands (agenda, free, conflicts, changes, load, acl-audit, rsvp-status, book) on the root command. The command implementations live in separate hand-authored files (internal/cli/gcal_*.go) that survive regeneration as whole units; only their AddCommand wiring touches the generated root.go.
patches.reason: The generator emits the spec-derived command tree but not novel features. Per the Printing Press novel-command pattern, the AddCommand calls go in root.go (re-injected by regen-merge). The eight gcal_*.go files are new hand-authored files, not edits to generated code, so they are not individually listed as patches.
patches.validated_outcome: All eight commands resolve as leaf commands; novel_features_check reports planned 7 / found 7 (book is the conflict-guarded create); shipcheck 6/6 PASS, scorecard 90/100.
